artworks.title: Le lever des ouvrieres en modes
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene showing a group of people engaged in a morning ritual in a room with a canopy bed. The room is adorned with elegant drapery hanging from a wooden beam ceiling. The central focus points to an intricately detailed bed with curtains drawn open. Around the bed and interior, various individuals are engaged in diverse activities. One person is sitting at a dressing table with a mirror, while others are involved in possibly dressing or conversing. There is a sense of lively yet serene morning routine captured. The texture is finely detailed, emphasizing the elaborate clothing and the patterned floor. A bust is placed on a cupboard in the background, and a small circular object lies on the floor.

artworks.title: Le lever des ouvrieres en modes
artworks.description: The image depicts an indoor scene with several individuals, mostly women, in a room with wooden beams on the ceiling. The women are engaged in various activities such as adjusting clothing, helping each other dress, doing hair, and conversing. The room is modestly furnished with a bed, a small table, a chair, and a chest or cabinet. On the ground, there are baskets and textiles.

artworks.title: Le coucher des ouvrieres en modes
artworks.description: The engraving shows several women in a dimly lit room engaged in various activities. One woman leans against a drawer, two women are seated at a table working, another woman stands holding fabric, and another woman is seated in conversation with a standing woman. The women wear elegant gowns and have styled hair. In the background, a woman is changing clothes near a bed canopy. The room has wooden ceiling beams, a painting on the wall, and a small table with a mirror.

artworks.title: Les offres seduisantes
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a room. In the foreground, a man sits on a chair leaning back slightly and holding a woman standing beside him. The man has curly hair and wears a long robe, while the woman has an elaborate hairstyle and wears a gown with a sash. They are surrounded by furniture including a chair and a roll-top desk with papers. In the background, another woman is partially visible behind a folding screen. The room is elegantly decorated with paneled walls and curtain-draped windows, softly lit.

artworks.title: Le petit favori
artworks.description: The image features a woman lying in a luxurious bed, her body partially covered by white bedclothes. She is positioned on her back with legs raised, holding a circular object toward a small dog standing on her legs. The woman has delicate facial features, light-colored hair with a white cap, and is wearing a light nightgown. Ornate drapery in blue and gold hangs in a canopy over the bed. A lit candle is on a bedside table to her left, and an elaborate chair is nearby with clothing items draped over it. The room has decorative walls with a pattern and a floral carpet on the floor.

artworks.title: Le joli chien
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person reclining on a bed covered with draped fabric, with a small dog nearby. The person is positioned on their side with one arm raised, wearing a bonnet and elegant clothing. The room is elaborately furnished, with a candle on a bedside table and ornate curtains with fringe details enclosing the bed. A chair piled with fabrics is slightly visible on the right side. The setting suggests a period ambiance, indicated by the furniture and clothing style.

artworks.title: Le repentir tardif
artworks.artist: Gerard Rene Le Vilain after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in a room. One person is seated on a chair, wearing an elegant dress, and the other person is kneeling in front of them, wearing a coat and breeches. Elaborate hairstyles are present on both individuals. The room features decorative walls, a canopied bed, sconces, and a chair draped with fabric.

artworks.title: Le repentir tardif
artworks.artist: Gerard Rene Le Vilain after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: There are two people in the image. One person is seated on a chair with striped fabric, while the other person kneels beside them. The seated person leans back with their left arm raised, covering their eyes, while the other person supports them. The seated person has wavy hair styled up and wears a light-colored dress with lace detailing. The other person has shoulder-length hair, is dressed in 18th-century fashion, and is wearing a long coat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes. The room has ornate wall decorations, a framed oval portrait or mirror, a grand canopied bed, wall sconces, and scattered belongings on the floor, including shoes and a small box.

artworks.title: Le repentir tardif
artworks.artist: Gerard Rene Le Vilain after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an elaborately decorated interior. The woman is seated on a chair, with her body leaning back and her left hand raised to her face. Beside her, a man is kneeling and extends his arms toward the woman. The interior is richly furnished, featuring a canopied bed, a round table, and wallpaper adorned with framed motifs. The room’s walls have decorative urns and wall sconces.

artworks.title: Le restaurant
artworks.artist: Jeanne Deny or Martial Deny after Niclas Lafrensen II
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an ornate room. A man and a woman are seated on a luxurious canopied bed in a half-hidden alcove, while another person, a woman, stands beside them. The seated woman has a delicate face with intricate hairstyle adorned with flowers. The man beside her has medium-length hair styled in soft waves. They both gaze towards each other and are dressed in opulent clothing. The standing woman is turned partially away and wears an elaborate gown. She holds a small cup or object, possibly offering it to the seated couple. The room is richly decorated, with a grand draped canopy over the bed, an ornate urn on a pedestal, an elegantly designed chair, and a large floral arrangement on a table by an archway.

artworks.title: Le restaurant
artworks.artist: Jeanne Deny or Martial Deny after Niclas Lafrensen II
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a ornately decorated room. Two people are seated on a luxurious upholstered couch on the left side, engaged in conversation. A third person is standing on the right side, holding a tray. In the foreground, there is a patterned chair and a musical instrument. The background features drapery, plush curtains, an urn on a pedestal, and a piece of furniture with a floral arrangement. The room is enclosed by intricate architectural elements and bordered by an elaborate frame.

artworks.title: Le consomme
artworks.artist: Jeanne Deny or Martial Deny after Niclas Lafrensen II
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in an opulent room. Two individuals sit on a high-backed sofa; one leans towards the other. The male figure has an 18th-century hairstyle and wears a coat, knee-length pants, and stockings. The female figure reclines on the man, wearing a frilly dress with lace. A servant approaches holding a tray with a dish. A small dog sits near the couple. In the background, there are decorative elements like a statue in a niche and ornate wall panels. Curtains frame the statue.

artworks.title: Le retour trop precipite
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a garden setting. A woman is seated on the ground, leaning back slightly with her upper body supported by her arms, gazing upwards towards a man who is kneeling beside her while holding her hand. The woman has curly hair and wears a flowing dress with a ruffled neckline. The man, who leans towards her, is dressed in a coat and breeches and has his hair tied back. Behind them, a second woman walks towards them. She wears a large hat adorned with bows and a full-length dress with wide skirts, and her hair is styled in curls under her hat. The first woman and the man both appear relaxed, surrounded by dense foliage. Near them, a small dog lies on the ground. To the left of the image, there is a statue of a cherub on a pedestal. In the background, tall trees frame the scene, and fluffy clouds are visible in the sky above.

artworks.title: Le roman dangereux
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a lavishly decorated room. One person is lying on a plush bed with ornate drapery, wearing an elaborate gown. The other individual is seated beside the bed, leaning slightly forward. The room has high ceilings with intricate moldings and ornamental decorations such as a large vase and floral arrangements.

artworks.title: Les sabots
artworks.description: The image shows a couple seated on the grass beneath a large, leafy tree. The horizon is not distinctly visible in the intimate setting. The detailed engraving style features fine lines creating texture and depth. The monochromatic palette consists of shades of gray and black. A basket with a ribbon is near the couple, with a hat on the grass. Trees extend into the distance with a sky of clouds above.

artworks.title: Le seducteur
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals in a lavishly decorated interior. On the right, a woman is reclined against a bed or chaise, wearing an elegant gown, and holding a dog on her lap. Another man is seated on the floor to her left. Three other figures are clustered further left; a standing man with a tricorn hat, a woman with elaborate hair, and another woman. The figures wear 18th-century clothing. The room has wooden paneling, ornate ceiling molding, an oval portrait on the wall, and a draped curtain. The floor has an intricate pattern, and there is a side table in the room.

artworks.title: Si tu voulais
artworks.artist: Louis Le Coeur after Nicolas Lavreince
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals with their upper bodies visible. A woman stands on the left, holding the hem of her dress, while a man kneels before her, grasping her dress with one hand and holding a cane in the other. The woman has curly hair tied with a ribbon and delicate facial features. She wears a dress with a light-colored blouse and a dark skirt. The man has slightly longer, curled hair and is dressed in an elegant, striped coat with blue hues and tan trousers. He looks up at the woman with intent focus. A bouquet of flowers is present. The background includes a clear sky with some clouds, a tree, and part of a structure with a striped awning, suggesting an outdoor setting near a building.

artworks.title: Valmont and Emilie
artworks.description: This is a painting of an opulently decorated room with a detailed interior. It features a canopy bed with curtains, an intricately adorned wall with carved panels and a bust on a pedestal. The forefront showcases rich fabrics like drapes, bedding, and garments with delicate coloring. The style is reminiscent of classic European Rococo art.

artworks.title: Le coup de vent (The Gust of Wind)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with two human figures, a dog, and a cupid. The figures appear engaged in a playful movement, with one gesturing and the other maintaining balance. A dog is nearby, and a cherubic cupid is pointing an arrow. The background includes a rocky landscape with a waterfall and overhanging branches.

artworks.title: Le coup de vent (The Gust of Wind)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people in full body - a woman and a man. The woman is on tiptoe and leaning slightly forward, with her skirt billowing. She has delicate facial features and styled hair in an updo. The man stands close to her, leaning towards her with a protective posture. He has curly hair and wears a suit with knee-high boots, holding a staff or stick. A small child is seated to their right, partially obscured by the man. A dog is to the left of the couple. The setting is a lush natural environment with overhanging tree branches and a rocky backdrop.

artworks.title: Queen Marie-Antoinette
artworks.artist: Pierre-Michel Alix after Élisabeth-Louise Vigée Le Brun
artworks.medium: color etching and wash manner on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman within an ornate frame surrounding her portrait. She is facing forward with a slight turn to her left. Her facial features include a fair complexion, rosy cheeks, and a composed expression. She has light brown, curly hair styled high atop her head with a feathered accessory and a large blue ribbon or bow. She wears a low-cut, white blouse or dress with ruffled lace and a richer blue garment partially visible. She also wears delicate earrings. The background inside the oval frame is dark, contrasting with her features. The outer background consists of a textured pattern of light bricks with surrounding text and decorative elements, including laurel leaves and ribbon accents.

artworks.title: La cage symbolique (The Symbolic Cage)
artworks.description: The image shows three people; a woman seated on the right, a man and a young girl standing near her. The woman is seated on a cushioned chair, wearing a ruffled dress, an ornate hat with feathers, and holding an open book. The man is kneeling slightly towards the left, shown in profile, with short hair and wearing a tailored coat. The girl stands between them, holding a birdcage with a bird inside. She has her hair styled up and wears an elaborate dress. The setting is an opulent interior with draped curtains, wall paneling, and a decorative emblem. A side table holds vases and a candlestick, and a dog is seated on the floor to the right of the girl.

artworks.title: L'amour a l'espagnole
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin and Noël Pruneau after Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair with a man partially in the background. The woman appears relaxed with her head tilted to the side, eyes possibly closed. She has elaborate curled hair and wears a detailed gown with lace and ruffles. She sits near a table with a bouquet of flowers. The man is by a window playing a stringed instrument. The background includes a patterned wall, a carpet, a round mirror, figurines on a mantel, and a window with a floral view.

artworks.title: L'amour a l'espagnole
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin and Noël Pruneau after Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting in a chair with her eyes closed and head resting on the chair's back. She has styled hair, delicate facial features, and is wearing an intricate gown with a necklace. A man is playing a stringed instrument next to her through a window. There is a bouquet of flowers on a table and a fireplace mantel in the background with various decorative items. Through the window, tree branches can be seen.
